status_semantics.implemented: Code path exists; verification/validation is not implied.

packages.name: Nonlinear solver and convergence
gaps: automatic initialization strategies remain intentionally unqualified; provided/uniform/restart are the declared validated modes
continuation failure/recovery remains unit-qualified but is not yet part of the canonical qualification corridors

qualification breadth now covers two resolutions by two Reynolds corridors on the lid-driven cavity (tests/validation/test_n7_convergence_qualification.cpp --breadth, 16x16x2 and 32x32x2 at Re=100 and Re=400). Continuation reproduces the direct solve across the whole matrix to <=1.6e-8 relative. Adaptive relaxation reproduces it on all four corridors to <=2.3e-4 relative (1.17e-5 at Re=100/32x32, 2.15e-5 at Re=100/16x16, 7.85e-5 at Re=400/32x32, 2.25e-4 at Re=400/16x16), each reaching the 1e-8 convergence contract. The previously documented Re=400/16x16 stall is repaired: it had parked on a false plateau at a 7.83e-3 relative residual against a 1e-8 contract, identically at a 625- and a 2500-iteration budget, so it was budget-insensitive rather than merely slow. The cause was the controller rather than the relaxation envelope. It compared each residual against the immediately preceding one, and the nonlinear metric on that corridor is noisy enough that the one-step ratio carries no trend, so alpha sawtoothed between its bounds while the residual sat on the plateau. Comparing against a smoothed reference instead (an exponential average over reference_window iterations, default 10, validated >= 2) makes the decision reflect genuine progress rather than iteration-to-iteration scatter; the corridor now reaches the contract. The by-name stall assertion is retained with an empty tolerated list, because it is what surfaced this repair and will surface the next one
no geometry other than the lid-driven cavity is covered; the 64^2 corridor is excluded from the breadth matrix on cost grounds and no spatial accuracy trend is measured across it

spatial observed-order evidence is merge-gated only as a 16/32/64 trend tripwire (tests/validation/test_ghia_cavity.cpp --gate, order U_RMS=2.05, V_RMS=1.16); the full 32/64/128 plus Re=400/Re=1000 campaign runs weekly on schedule and establishes neither the spatial accuracy of the continuation or adaptive paths nor a general order on other schemes, meshes or geometries

rules.rule: Implementation registry entries do not imply validation.
Limiter coefficient tests do not by themselves qualify convection schemes.
Approximate Schur is not exact Schur.
Residual convergence does not replace conservation, boundedness or QoI evidence.
Backend support does not imply numerical equivalence.
